cases.title: Discard password when Never For This Site is selected
cases.description: Verify that when Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box, the browser discards the password.

cases.title: Available Choices for Multiple Saved Credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Update saved password
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website is saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Password Manager Disabled Stops Save Prompts
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords.

cases.title: Password Manager Disabled Stops Prefilled Info
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in password manager through preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, this information can be viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Removed credentials do not autofill on the site
cases.description: Verify that after removing a username and password for a given site, it no longer autofills on that site.

cases.title: Removed credentials are no longer listed in password manager
cases.description: Verify that after removing a username and password for a given site, it is no longer listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information stops autofill
cases.description: Verify that when all username and password information is removed, it no longer autofills on sites.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information clears password manager listing
cases.description: Verify that when all username and password information is removed, nothing is listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have corresponding test cases covering their explicitly described normal and functional behaviors.
All requirements have been properly covered by the test cases and no blockers or missing scenario gaps were identified.

analysis.analysis: Requirement R-102: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box. Expected outcome: The browser discards the password. Requirement R-103: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Trigger: Multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved. Expected outcome: Those same choices are later available to be presented. Requirement R-104: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Trigger: A username and password for a website is saved and later the password is changed. Expected outcome: The password manager picks up the new password. Requirement R-105: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Password manager from the preferences panel is disabled. Expected outcome 1: The browser no longer asks to save passwords. Expected outcome 2: The browser no longer gets prefilled info on sites. Requirement R-106: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Trigger: A username and password in the password manager is saved. Expected outcome: This information can be viewed in the password manager through preferences. Requirement R-107: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Removing a username and password for a given site. Expected outcome 1: It no longer autofills on that site. Expected outcome 2: It is no longer listed in the password manager. Requirement R-108: Multiple distinct behaviors. Trigger: Removing all username and password information. Expected outcome 1: It no longer autofills. Expected outcome 2: Nothing is listed in the password manager.
